units.zh: 竇泰 尉景 婁昭 兄子叡 厙狄干 子士文 韓軌 潘樂
units.en: Dou Tai; Wei Jing; Lou Zhao; nephew Rui; Kudie Gan; son Shiwen; Han Gui; Pan Le
units.literal: Dou Tai; Wei Jing; Lou Zhao; nephew Rui; Kudie Gan; son Shiwen; Han Gui; Pan Le

units.zh: 竇泰，字世寧，大安捍殊人也。
units.en: Dou Tai, courtesy name Shining, was a native of Da'an Hanshu.
units.literal: Dou Tai, courtesy name Shining, was a native of Da'an Hanshu.

units.zh: 本出清河觀津，曾祖羅，魏統萬鎮將，因居北邊。
units.en: His family originally came from Guanjin in Qinghe; his great-grandfather Luo was general of the Wei garrison at Tongwan and settled on the northern frontier.
units.literal: His family originally came from Guanjin in Qinghe; his great-grandfather Luo was general of the Wei garrison at Tongwan and settled on the northern frontier.

units.zh: 父樂，魏末破六韓拔陵為亂，與鎮將楊鈞固守，遇害。
units.en: His father Yue, when Poliuhan Baling rebelled at the end of Wei, held firm with the garrison general Yang Jun and was killed in action.
units.literal: His father Yue, when Poliuhan Baling rebelled at the end of Wei, held firm with the garrison general Yang Jun and was killed in action.

units.zh: 泰貴，追贈司徒。
units.en: When Dou Tai rose high, his father Yue was posthumously made minister of education.
units.literal: When Tai rose high, Yue was posthumously made minister of education.

units.zh: 初，泰母夢風雷暴起，若有雨狀，出庭觀之，見電光奪目，駛雨霑灑，寤而驚汗，遂有娠。
units.en: At first Dou Tai's mother dreamed that wind and thunder burst up as though rain were coming; she went out to the courtyard to watch and saw lightning dazzle her eyes and driving rain spatter down; waking in a sweat of alarm, she conceived.
units.literal: At first Tai's mother dreamed that wind and thunder burst up as though rain were coming; she went out to the courtyard to watch and saw lightning dazzle her eyes and driving rain spatter down; waking in a sweat of alarm, she conceived.

units.zh: 期而不產，大懼。
units.en: When her term passed without birth, she was greatly afraid.
units.literal: When her term passed without birth, she was greatly afraid.

units.zh: 有巫曰：「渡河湔裙，產子必易。」
units.en: A witch said, "Cross the river and wash your skirt, and the birth will surely come easily."
units.literal: A witch said, "Cross the river and wash your skirt, and the birth will surely come easily."

units.zh: 便向水所。
units.en: She went at once toward the water.
units.literal: She went at once toward the water.

units.zh: 忽見一人，曰：「當生貴子，可徙而南。」
units.en: Suddenly she saw a man who said, "You will bear a noble son; move south."
units.literal: Suddenly she saw a man who said, "You will bear a noble son; move south."

units.zh: 泰母從之。
units.en: Dou Tai's mother obeyed.
units.literal: Tai's mother obeyed.

units.zh: 俄而生泰。
units.en: Soon afterward Dou Tai was born.
units.literal: Soon afterward Tai was born.

units.zh: 及長，善騎射，有勇略。
units.en: When he grew up, he was skilled at riding and archery and possessed courage and strategy.
units.literal: When he grew up, he was skilled at riding and archery and possessed courage and strategy.

units.zh: 泰父兄戰歿於鎮，泰身負骸骨歸尒朱榮。
units.en: Dou Tai's father and elder brother died in battle at the garrison; Dou Tai personally carried their bones back to Erzhu Rong.
units.literal: Tai's father and elder brother died in battle at the garrison; Tai personally carried their bones back to Erzhu Rong.

units.zh: 以從討邢杲功，賜爵廣阿子。
units.en: For following the campaign against Xing Gao and meriting success, he was granted the title viscount of Guanga.
units.literal: For following the campaign against Xing Gao and meriting success, he was granted the title Viscount of Guanga.

units.zh: 神武之為晉州，請泰為鎮城都督，參謀軍事。
units.en: When Gao Huan became governor of Jin Province, he requested Dou Tai as garrison-city commander and staff officer for military affairs.
units.literal: When Shenwu became governor of Jin Province, he requested Tai as garrison-city commander and staff officer for military affairs.

units.zh: 累遷侍中、京畿大都督，尋領御史中尉。
units.en: He rose in succession to palace attendant, grand commander of the capital region, and soon afterward also served as censor-in-chief.
units.literal: He rose in succession to palace attendant, grand commander of the capital region, and soon afterward also served as censor-in-chief.

units.zh: 泰以勳戚居臺，雖無多糾舉，而百僚畏懼。
units.en: Dou Tai, holding high office by merit and kinship, made few impeachments, yet the hundred officials feared him.
units.literal: Tai, holding high office by merit and kinship, made few impeachments, yet the hundred officials feared him.

units.zh: 天平三年，神武西討，令泰自潼關入。
units.en: In the third year of Tianping, Gao Huan campaigned west and ordered Dou Tai to enter by Tong Pass.
units.literal: In the third year of Tianping, Shenwu campaigned west and ordered Tai to enter by Tong Pass.

units.zh: 四年，泰至小關，為周文帝所襲，衆盡沒，泰自殺。
units.en: In the fourth year Dou Tai reached Little Pass, was ambushed by Yuwen Tai, and his whole force was destroyed; Dou Tai killed himself.
units.literal: In the fourth year Tai reached Little Pass, was ambushed by Emperor Wen of Zhou, and his whole force was destroyed; Tai killed himself.

units.zh: 初，泰將發鄴，鄴有惠化尼謠云：「竇行臺，去不回。」
units.en: At first, when Dou Tai was about to set out from Ye, a ballad of the nun Huihua in Ye said, "Commandery Chief Dou goes and does not return."
units.literal: At first, when Tai was about to set out from Ye, a ballad of the nun Huihua in Ye said, "Commandery Chief Dou goes and does not return."

units.zh: 未行之前，夜三更，忽有朱衣冠幘數千人入臺，云「收竇中尉」，宿直兵吏皆驚，其人入數屋，俄頃而去。
units.en: Before he marched, at the third watch of the night, suddenly several thousand men in red robes and caps entered the censorate, saying they had come "to arrest Censor Dou"; the night guards and clerks were all alarmed; the figures entered several rooms and in a moment were gone.
units.literal: Before he marched, at the third watch of the night, suddenly several thousand men in red robes and caps entered the censorate, saying they had come "to arrest Censor Dou"; the night guards and clerks were all alarmed; the figures entered several rooms and in a moment were gone.

units.zh: 旦視關鍵不異，方知非人。
units.en: At dawn they looked and the locks were unchanged; only then did they know these were not human beings.
units.literal: At dawn they looked and the locks were unchanged; only then did they know these were not human beings.

units.zh: 皆知其必敗。
units.en: All knew he was doomed to defeat.
units.literal: All knew he was doomed to defeat.

units.zh: 贈大司馬、太尉、錄尚書事，諡曰武貞。
units.en: Posthumously he was made grand marshal, grand commandant, and recorder of affairs of the masters of writing; his posthumous title was Wuzhen.
units.literal: Posthumously he was made grand marshal, grand commandant, and recorder of affairs of the masters of writing; his posthumous title was Wuzhen.

units.zh: 泰妻，武明婁后妹也。
units.en: Dou Tai's wife was the younger sister of Empress Lou Wuming.
units.literal: Tai's wife was the younger sister of Empress Lou Wuming.

units.zh: 泰雖以親見待，而功名自建。
units.en: Although Dou Tai was treated as kin, his fame and achievement were his own.
units.literal: Although Tai was treated as kin, his fame and achievement were his own.

units.zh: 齊受禪，祭告其墓。
units.en: When Qi received the abdication, sacrifice was announced at his tomb.
units.literal: When Qi received the abdication, sacrifice was announced at his tomb.

units.zh: 皇建初，配享神武廟庭。
units.en: At the beginning of Huangjian he was given associated sacrifice in Gao Huan's temple court.
units.literal: At the beginning of Huangjian he was given associated sacrifice in Shenwu's temple court.

units.zh: 子孝敬嗣。
units.en: His son Xiaojing succeeded.
units.literal: His son Xiaojing succeeded.

units.zh: 位儀同三司。
units.en: He rose to Equal-to-the-Three-Dukes (yitong sansi).
units.literal: He rose to Equal-to-the-Three-Dukes (yitong sansi).

units.zh: 尉景，字士真，善無人也。
units.en: Wei Jing, styled Shizhen, was a native of Shanwu.
units.literal: Wei Jing, styled Shizhen, was a native of Shanwu.

units.zh: 秦、漢置尉候官，其先有居此職者，因以氏焉。
units.en: In Qin and Han the office of frontier scout was established; an ancestor who had held that post took it as the clan surname.
units.literal: In Qin and Han the office of frontier scout was established; an ancestor who had held that post took it as the clan surname.

units.zh: 景性溫厚，頗有俠氣。
units.en: Jing was warm by nature and possessed a chivalrous spirit.
units.literal: Jing was warm by nature and possessed a chivalrous spirit.

units.zh: 魏孝昌中，北鎮反，景與神武入杜洛周軍中，仍共歸尒朱榮。
units.en: In the Xiaochang era of Wei, when the northern garrisons rebelled, Jing entered Du Luozhou's army together with Gao Huan and then both returned to Erzhu Rong.
units.literal: In the Xiaochang era of Wei, when the northern garrisons rebelled, Jing entered Du Luozhou's army together with Shenwu and then both returned to Erzhu Rong.

units.zh: 以軍功封博野縣伯。
units.en: For military merit he was enfeoffed baron of Boye County.
units.literal: For military merit he was enfeoffed baron of Boye County.

units.zh: 後從神武起兵信都。
units.en: Later he followed Gao Huan in raising troops at Xindu.
units.literal: Later he followed Shenwu in raising troops at Xindu.

units.zh: 韓陵之戰，唯景所統失利。
units.en: At the Battle of Hanling, only the force Jing commanded suffered defeat.
units.literal: At the Battle of Hanling, only the force Jing commanded suffered defeat.

units.zh: 神武入洛，留景鎮鄴。
units.en: When Gao Huan entered Luoyang, he left Jing to garrison Ye.
units.literal: When Shenwu entered Luoyang, he left Jing to garrison Ye.

units.zh: 尋進封為公。
units.en: Soon afterward his rank was advanced to duke.
units.literal: Soon afterward his rank was advanced to duke.

units.zh: 景妻常山君，神武之姊也。
units.en: Jing's wife, Lady Changshan, was Gao Huan's elder sister.
units.literal: Jing's wife, Lady Changshan, was Shenwu's elder sister.

units.zh: 以勳戚，每有軍事，與厙狄干常被委重，而不能忘懷財利，神武每嫌責之。
units.en: As a meritorious kinsman, whenever there was military business he and Kudie Gan were often entrusted with weighty command, yet he could not put aside profit; Gao Huan frequently reproved him for it.
units.literal: As a meritorious kinsman, whenever there was military business he and Kudie Gan were often entrusted with weighty command, yet he could not put aside profit; Shenwu frequently reproved him for it.

units.zh: 轉冀州刺史，又大納賄，發夫獵，死者三百人。
units.en: Transferred to governor of Ji Province, he again took large bribes and pressed laborers into a hunt in which three hundred men died.
units.literal: Transferred to governor of Ji Province, he again took large bribes and pressed laborers into a hunt in which three hundred men died.

units.zh: 厙狄干與景在神武坐，請作御史中尉。
units.en: Kudie Gan and Jing, while seated with Gao Huan, asked to serve as censor-in-chief.
units.literal: Kudie Gan and Jing, while seated with Shenwu, asked to serve as censor-in-chief.

units.zh: 神武曰：「何意下求卑官？」
units.en: Gao Huan said, "Why do you seek so low an office?"
units.literal: Shenwu said, "Why do you seek so low an office?"

units.zh: 干曰：「欲捉尉景。」
units.en: Kudie Gan said, "To arrest Wei Jing."
units.literal: Gan said, "To arrest Wei Jing."

units.zh: 神武大笑，令優者石董桶戲之。
units.en: Gao Huan laughed greatly and had the actor Shi Dongtong mock them.
units.literal: Shenwu laughed greatly and had the actor Shi Dongtong mock them.

units.zh: 董桶剝景衣，曰：「公剝百姓，董桶何為不剝公！」
units.en: Dongtong stripped Jing's clothes and said, "You strip the common people — why should Dongtong not strip you!"
units.literal: Dongtong stripped Jing's clothes and said, "You strip the common people — why should Dongtong not strip you!"

units.zh: 神武誡景曰：「可以無貪也。」
units.en: Gao Huan admonished Jing, "You can do without greed."
units.literal: Shenwu admonished Jing, "You can do without greed."

units.zh: 景曰：「與爾計生活孰多，我止人上取，爾割天子調。」
units.en: Jing said, "When we reckon whose way of living brings in more, I only take from people; you carve off the emperor's taxes."
units.literal: Jing said, "When we reckon whose way of living brings in more, I only take from people; you carve off the emperor's taxes."

units.zh: 神武笑不答。
units.en: Gao Huan smiled and did not answer.
units.literal: Shenwu smiled and did not answer.

units.zh: 改長樂郡公。
units.en: His title was changed to duke of Changle Commandery.
units.literal: His title was changed to Duke of Changle Commandery.

units.zh: 歷位太保、太傅，坐匿亡人見禁止。
units.en: He rose in succession to grand guardian and grand tutor, then was imprisoned for concealing a fugitive.
units.literal: He rose in succession to grand guardian and grand tutor, then was imprisoned for concealing a fugitive.

units.zh: 使崔暹謂文襄曰：「語阿惠兒，富貴欲殺我耶！」
units.en: He had Cui Xian tell Gao Cheng, "Tell Ahuier — does his wealth and power mean to kill me!"
units.literal: He had Cui Xian tell Wenshuang, "Tell Ahuier — does his wealth and power mean to kill me!"

units.zh: 神武聞之泣，詣闕曰：「臣非尉景，無以至今日。」
units.en: Gao Huan heard and wept; he went to the palace and said, "Were it not for Wei Jing, your subject would never have reached today."
units.literal: Shenwu heard and wept; he went to the palace and said, "Were it not for Wei Jing, your subject would never have reached today."

units.zh: 三請，帝乃許之。
units.en: After three petitions the emperor granted it.
units.literal: After three petitions the emperor granted it.

units.zh: 於是黜為驃騎大將軍、開府儀同三司。
units.en: Thereupon he was demoted to general of the imperial horse and opener of a government office equal in protocol to three imperators.
units.literal: Thereupon he was demoted to general of the imperial horse and opener of a government office equal in protocol to three imperators.

units.zh: 神武造之，景恚臥不動，叫曰：「殺我時趣耶！」
units.en: Gao Huan visited him; Jing lay in anger and would not rise, shouting, "If you're going to kill me, hurry up!"
units.literal: Shenwu visited him; Jing lay in anger and would not rise, shouting, "If you're going to kill me, hurry up!"

units.zh: 常山君謂神武曰：「老人去死近，何忍煎迫至此。」
units.en: Lady Changshan said to Gao Huan, "The old man is near death — how can you press him so cruelly?"
units.literal: Lady Changshan said to Shenwu, "The old man is near death — how can you press him so cruelly?"

units.zh: 又曰：「我為爾汲水胝生。」
units.en: She also said, "I drew water for you until calluses formed on my hands."
units.literal: She also said, "I drew water for you until calluses formed on my hands."

units.zh: 因出其掌。
units.en: She then showed her palms.
units.literal: She then showed her palms.

units.zh: 神武撫景，為之屈膝。
units.en: Gao Huan comforted Jing and knelt before him.
units.literal: Shenwu comforted Jing and knelt before him.

units.zh: 先是，景有果下馬，文襄求之，景不與，曰：「土相扶為墻，人相扶為王，一馬亦不得畜而索也。」
units.en: Before this Jing had a pony; Gao Cheng asked for it, and Jing would not give it, saying, "Earth piled together makes a wall; men supporting one another make a king — not even one horse may be kept and then demanded back."
units.literal: Before this Jing had a pony; Wenshuang asked for it, and Jing would not give it, saying, "Earth piled together makes a wall; men supporting one another make a king — not even one horse may be kept and then demanded back."

units.zh: 神武對景及常山君責文襄而杖之。
units.en: Gao Huan, before Jing and Lady Changshan, rebuked Gao Cheng and had him beaten.
units.literal: Shenwu, before Jing and Lady Changshan, rebuked Wenshuang and had him beaten.

units.zh: 常山君泣救之。
units.en: Lady Changshan wept and pleaded for him.
units.literal: Lady Changshan wept and pleaded for him.

units.zh: 景曰：「小兒慣去，放使作心腹，何須干啼濕哭不聽打耶！」
units.en: Jing said, "The boy is used to indulgence — let him learn to be a trusted man; why all this weeping and wailing to stop a beating!"
units.literal: Jing said, "The boy is used to indulgence — let him learn to be a trusted man; why all this weeping and wailing to stop a beating!"

units.zh: 尋授青州刺史，操行頗改，百姓安之。
units.en: Soon afterward he was appointed governor of Qing Province; his conduct improved greatly, and the people lived at ease.
units.literal: Soon afterward he was appointed governor of Qing Province; his conduct improved greatly, and the people lived at ease.

units.zh: 徵授大司馬。
units.en: Summoned back, he was made grand marshal.
units.literal: Summoned back, he was made grand marshal.

units.zh: 遇疾，薨於州。
units.en: He fell ill and died in the province.
units.literal: He fell ill and died in the province.

units.zh: 贈太師、尚書令。
units.en: Posthumously he was made grand preceptor and director of the masters of writing.
units.literal: Posthumously he was made grand preceptor and director of the masters of writing.

units.zh: 齊受禪，以景元勳，詔祭告其墓。
units.en: When Qi received the abdication, because Jing was an original meritorious minister, an edict ordered sacrifice announced at his tomb.
units.literal: When Qi received the abdication, because Jing was an original meritorious minister, an edict ordered sacrifice announced at his tomb.

units.zh: 皇建初，配享神武廟庭，追封長樂王。
units.en: At the beginning of Huangjian he was given associated sacrifice in Gao Huan's temple court and posthumously enfeoffed prince of Changle.
units.literal: At the beginning of Huangjian he was given associated sacrifice in Shenwu's temple court and posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Changle.

units.zh: 子粲，少歷顯職，性粗武。
units.en: His son Can, from youth, held prominent posts; by nature he was coarse and martial.
units.literal: His son Can, from youth, held prominent posts; by nature he was coarse and martial.

units.zh: 天保初，封厙狄干等為王，粲以父不預王爵，大恚恨，十餘日閉門不朝。
units.en: At the beginning of Tianbao, Kudie Gan and others were enfeoffed as princes; Can, because his father had not received a princely title, was greatly resentful and for more than ten days shut his door and did not attend court.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianbao, Kudie Gan and others were enfeoffed as princes; Can, because his father had not received a princely title, was greatly resentful and for more than ten days shut his door and did not attend court.

units.zh: 帝怪，遣使就宅問之。
units.en: The emperor thought it strange and sent an envoy to his house to inquire.
units.literal: The emperor thought it strange and sent an envoy to his house to inquire.

units.zh: 隔門謂使者曰：「天子不封粲父為王，粲不如死。」
units.en: Through the closed door he told the envoy, "If the Son of Heaven will not enfeoff Can's father as a prince, Can would rather die."
units.literal: Through the closed door he told the envoy, "If the Son of Heaven will not enfeoff Can's father as a prince, Can would rather die."

units.zh: 使云：「須開門受勑。」
units.en: The envoy said, "You must open the door to receive the edict."
units.literal: The envoy said, "You must open the door to receive the edict."

units.zh: 粲遂彎弓隔門射使者。
units.en: Can thereupon bent his bow and shot at the envoy through the door.
units.literal: Can thereupon bent his bow and shot at the envoy through the door.

units.zh: 使者以狀聞之，文宣使段韶諭旨。
units.en: The envoy reported the matter; Gao Yang sent Duan Shao to deliver the imperial message.
units.literal: The envoy reported the matter; Wenxuan sent Duan Shao to deliver the imperial message.

units.zh: 粲見韶，唯撫膺大哭，不答一言。
units.en: When Can saw Shao, he only beat his breast and wept loudly, answering not a word.
units.literal: When Can saw Shao, he only beat his breast and wept loudly, answering not a word.

units.zh: 文宣親詣其宅慰之，方復朝請。
units.en: Gao Yang personally visited his house to comfort him; only then did he resume attending court.
units.literal: Wenxuan personally visited his house to comfort him; only then did he resume attending court.

units.zh: 尋追封景長樂王。
units.en: Soon afterward Jing was posthumously enfeoffed prince of Changle.
units.literal: Soon afterward Jing was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Changle.

units.zh: 粲襲爵。
units.en: Can inherited the title.
units.literal: Can inherited the title.

units.zh: 位司徒、太傅，薨。
units.en: He rose to minister of education and grand tutor, then died.
units.literal: He rose to minister of education and grand tutor, then died.

units.zh: 子世辯嗣。
units.en: His son Shibian succeeded.
units.literal: His son Shibian succeeded.

units.zh: 周師將入鄴，令辯出千餘騎覘候，出滏口，登高阜西望，遙見群烏飛起，謂是西軍旗幟，即馳還，比至紫陌橋，不敢回顧。
units.en: When the Zhou army was about to enter Ye, Shibian was ordered out with more than a thousand horsemen to reconnoiter; leaving by Fukou, he climbed a high mound and looked west; seeing flocks of birds rise in the distance, he took them for the banners of the Western army and galloped back — by the time he reached Zimo Bridge he dared not look behind him.
units.literal: When the Zhou army was about to enter Ye, Shibian was ordered out with more than a thousand horsemen to reconnoiter; leaving by Fukou, he climbed a high mound and looked west; seeing flocks of birds rise in the distance, he took them for the banners of the Western army and galloped back — by the time he reached Zimo Bridge he dared not look behind him.

units.zh: 隋開皇中，卒於浙州刺史。
units.en: In the Kaihuang era of Sui he died while serving as governor of Zhe Province.
units.literal: In the Kaihuang era of Sui he died while serving as governor of Zhe Province.

units.zh: 婁昭，字菩薩，代郡平城人也，武明皇後之母弟也。
units.en: Lou Zhao, styled Pusa, was a native of Pingcheng in Dai Commandery and the maternal younger brother of Empress Lou Wuming.
units.literal: Lou Zhao, styled Pusa, was a native of Pingcheng in Dai Commandery and the maternal younger brother of Empress Lou Wuming.

units.zh: 祖父提，雄傑有識度，家僮千數，牛馬以谷量。
units.en: His grandfather Ti was bold and far-sighted; his household had a thousand servants, and cattle and horses were counted by the bushel.
units.literal: His grandfather Ti was bold and far-sighted; his household had a thousand servants, and cattle and horses were counted by the bushel.

units.zh: 性好周給，士多歸附之。
units.en: By nature he delighted in giving to others; many men of worth attached themselves to him.
units.literal: By nature he delighted in giving to others; many men of worth attached themselves to him.

units.zh: 魏太武時，以功封真定侯。
units.en: In the reign of Emperor Taiwu of Wei he was enfeoffed marquis of Zhending for merit.
units.literal: In the reign of Emperor Taiwu of Wei he was enfeoffed marquis of Zhending for merit.

units.zh: 父內干，有武力，未仕而卒。
units.en: His father Neigan possessed martial strength but died before holding office.
units.literal: His father Neigan possessed martial strength but died before holding office.

units.zh: 昭貴，魏朝贈司徒。
units.en: When Lou Zhao rose high, the Wei court posthumously made his father Neigan minister of education.
units.literal: When Zhao rose high, the Wei court posthumously made Neigan minister of education.

units.zh: 齊受禪，追封太原王。
units.en: When Qi received the abdication, Lou Zhao's father Neigan was posthumously enfeoffed prince of Taiyuan.
units.literal: When Qi received the abdication, Neigan was posthumously enfeoffed Prince of Taiyuan.

units.zh: 昭方雅正直，有大度深謀，腰帶八尺，弓馬冠世。
units.en: Lou Zhao was dignified, upright, and of great bearing, with deep designs; his belt was eight feet long, and in archery and horsemanship he stood first in the age.
units.literal: Zhao was dignified, upright, and of great bearing, with deep designs; his belt was eight feet long, and in archery and horsemanship he stood first in the age.

units.zh: 神武少親重之。
units.en: From youth Gao Huan treated him with close regard.
units.literal: From youth Shenwu treated him with close regard.

units.zh: 昭亦早識人，恒曲盡禮敬。
units.en: Lou Zhao also recognized men early and always showed them full courtesy and respect.
units.literal: Zhao also recognized men early and always showed them full courtesy and respect.

units.zh: 數隨神武獵，每致請不宜乘危歷階。
units.en: He often followed Gao Huan on hunts and each time urged that one should not ride through danger or up steep slopes.
units.literal: He often followed Shenwu on hunts and each time urged that one should not ride through danger or up steep slopes.

units.zh: 神武將出信都，昭贊成大策，卽以為中軍大都督。
units.en: When Gao Huan was about to march out from Xindu, Zhao endorsed the grand plan and was immediately made Grand Commander of the Central Army.
units.literal: When Shenwu was about to set out from Xindu, Zhao endorsed the grand plan and was at once made Grand Commander of the Central Army.

units.zh: 從破尒朱兆於廣阿，封安喜縣伯，改濟北公，又徙濮陽郡公，授領軍將軍。
units.en: He took part in the defeat of Erzhu Zhao at Guang'a, was enfeoffed as Baron of Anxi County, then made Duke of Jibei and later Duke of Puyang Commandery, and was appointed General of the Guard Army.
units.literal: He followed in defeating Erzhu Zhao at Guang'a, was enfeoffed as Baron of Anxi County, changed to Duke of Jibei, then transferred to Duke of Puyang Commandery, and was appointed General of the Guard Army.

units.zh: 魏孝武將貳於神武，昭以疾辭還晉陽。
units.en: When Emperor Xiaowu of Wei was about to break with Gao Huan, Zhao pleaded illness and returned to Jinyang.
units.literal: When Emperor Xiaowu of Wei was about to become divided from Shenwu, Zhao excused himself on grounds of illness and returned to Jinyang.

units.zh: 從神武入洛，兗州刺史樊子鵠反，以昭為東道大都督討之。
units.en: He followed Gao Huan into Luoyang. When Fan Zihu, Inspector of Yan Province, rebelled, Zhao was made Grand Commander of the Eastern Route and sent to suppress him.
units.literal: He followed Shenwu into Luoyang; when Fan Zihu, Inspector of Yan Province, rebelled, Zhao was made Grand Commander of the Eastern Route to campaign against him.

units.zh: 子鵠既死，諸將勸昭盡捕誅其黨。
units.en: After Zihu was dead, the generals urged Zhao to arrest and execute all his followers.
units.literal: After Zihu had died, the generals urged Zhao to arrest and execute all of his followers.

units.zh: 昭曰：「此州無狀，橫被殘賊，其君是怨，其人何罪。」
units.en: Zhao said, "This province was helplessly overrun by violent rebels. Their lord is the one to blame. What crime have the people committed?"
units.literal: Zhao said, "This province was in poor condition and was violently overrun by cruel rebels; their lord is the one to blame, so what crime have the people committed?"

units.zh: 遂皆捨焉。
units.en: He released them all.
units.literal: Thereupon he released them all.

units.zh: 後轉大司馬，仍領軍。
units.en: He was later made Grand Marshal while retaining command of the Guard Army.
units.literal: Later he was transferred to Grand Marshal while still commanding the Guard Army.

units.zh: 遷司徒，出為定州刺史。
units.en: He was promoted to Minister over the Masses and sent out as Inspector of Ding Province.
units.literal: He was promoted to Minister over the Masses and sent out as Inspector of Ding Province.

units.zh: 昭好酒，晚得偏風，雖愈，猶不能處劇務，在州事委僚屬，昭舉其大綱而已。
units.en: Zhao loved wine and in later life suffered a stroke. Although he recovered, he still could not manage demanding business, so in the province he left affairs to his staff and handled only the broad outlines.
units.literal: Zhao liked wine, and in later life suffered a stroke; although he recovered, he still could not handle heavy business, so in the province he entrusted affairs to his staff and only took up the main outlines.

units.zh: 薨於州。
units.en: He died in the province.
units.literal: He died in the province.

units.zh: 贈假黃鉞、太師、太尉，諡曰武。
units.en: Posthumously he was granted the acting yellow battle-axe and the titles Grand Preceptor and Grand Commandant; his posthumous name was Wu.
units.literal: He was posthumously granted the acting yellow battle-axe, Grand Preceptor, and Grand Commandant; his posthumous name was Wu.

units.zh: 齊受禪，詔祭告其墓，封太原王。
units.en: When Qi received the abdication, an edict ordered sacrifices announced at his tomb, and he was enfeoffed as Prince of Taiyuan.
units.literal: When Qi received the abdication, an edict ordered sacrifice announced at his tomb, and he was enfeoffed as Prince of Taiyuan.

units.zh: 皇建初，配享神武廟庭。
units.en: At the beginning of Huangjian he was given associated sacrifice in Gao Huan's temple court.
units.literal: At the beginning of Huangjian he was given associated sacrifice in Shenwu's temple court.

units.zh: 長子仲達嗣，改封濮陽王。
units.en: His eldest son Zhongda succeeded him, and the title was changed to Prince of Puyang.
units.literal: His eldest son Zhongda succeeded and the title was changed to Prince of Puyang.

units.zh: 次子定遠，少歷顯職，外戚中偏為武成愛狎。
units.en: The second son Dingyuan, from youth, held prominent posts; among the imperial kin he was especially favored and intimate with Gao Zhan.
units.literal: The second son Dingyuan, from youth, held prominent posts; among the imperial kin he was especially favored and intimate with Wucheng.

units.zh: 別封臨淮郡王。
units.en: He was separately enfeoffed prince of Linhuai Commandery.
units.literal: He was separately enfeoffed Prince of Linhuai Commandery.

units.zh: 武成大漸，與趙郡王等同受顧命，位司空。
units.en: As Wucheng grew gravely ill, Dingyuan together with the Prince of Zhao Commandery Rui and others received the final testament; Dingyuan was made minister of works.
units.literal: As Wucheng grew gravely ill, he and Prince of Zhao Commandery Rui and others alike received the final testament; Dingyuan was made Minister of Works.

units.zh: 趙郡王之奏黜和士開，定遠與其謀，遂納士開賄賂，成趙郡之禍，其貪鄙如此。
units.en: When Prince of Zhao Commandery moved to dismiss He Shikai, Dingyuan joined the plot — then took He Shikai's bribe and brought ruin on the prince. Such was his greed.
units.literal: When Prince of Zhao Commandery memorialized to dismiss He Shikai, Dingyuan joined the plot — then accepted He Shikai's bribe, bringing calamity upon the prince; such was his greed and baseness.

units.zh: 尋除瀛州刺史。
units.en: Soon he was made governor of Ying Province.
units.literal: Soon he was appointed Governor of Ying Province.

units.zh: 初，定遠弟季略，穆提婆求其伎妾，定遠不許。
units.en: Earlier, Dingyuan's younger brother Jilue had a performing concubine. Mutipo demanded her; Dingyuan refused.
units.literal: Earlier, Dingyuan's younger brother Jilue had a performing concubine; Mutipo asked for her, and Dingyuan refused.

units.zh: 因高思好作亂，提婆令臨淮國郎中令告定遠陰與思好通。
units.en: When Gao Sihao rose in rebellion, Mutipo had the Linhuai principality's director accuse Dingyuan of secret dealings with Sihao.
units.literal: When Gao Sihao rebelled, Mutipo had the director of the Linhuai principality accuse Dingyuan of secretly communicating with Sihao.

units.zh: 後主令開府段暢率三千騎掩之，令侍御史趙秀通至州，以贓貨事劾定遠。
units.en: The Later Lord ordered Duan Chang, who held opening-establishment honors, to lead three thousand cavalry in a surprise raid, and sent attendant censor Zhao Xiutong to the province to impeach Dingyuan for embezzlement.
units.literal: The Later Lord ordered Duan Chang, holder of opening-establishment honors, to lead three thousand cavalry in a surprise strike, and sent Attendant Censor Zhao Xiutong to the province to impeach Dingyuan on charges of embezzlement.

units.zh: 定遠疑有變，遂縊而死。
units.en: Dingyuan sensed a trap and hanged himself.
units.literal: Dingyuan suspected a trap and hanged himself.

units.zh: 昭兄子叡。
units.en: Rui was Zhao's nephew, the son of his elder brother.
units.literal: Zhao's elder brother's son was Rui.

units.zh: 叡字佛仁，父拔，魏南部尚書。
units.en: Rui, courtesy name Furen, was the son of Ba, who had served in Wei as Minister of the Southern Section.
units.literal: Rui, courtesy name Furen, was the son of Ba, who was Wei Minister of the Southern Section.

units.zh: 叡幼孤，被叔父昭所養。
units.en: Rui was orphaned young and raised by his uncle Zhao.
units.literal: Rui was orphaned when young and was raised by his uncle Zhao.

units.zh: 為神武帳內都督，封掖縣子，累遷光州刺史。
units.en: He served as commandant in Gao Huan's personal retinue, was enfeoffed as Viscount of Ye County, and rose in succession to Inspector of Guang Province.
units.literal: He served as Shenwu's tent commandant, was enfeoffed as Viscount of Ye County, and rose successively to Inspector of Guang Province.

units.zh: 在任貪縱，深為文襄所責。
units.en: In office he was greedy and self-indulgent, and Gao Cheng sharply reprimanded him.
units.literal: In office he was greedy and unrestrained, and was sharply reproved by Wenxiang.

units.zh: 後改封九門縣公。
units.en: His title was later changed to Duke of Jiumen County.
units.literal: Later his title was changed to Duke of Jiumen County.

units.zh: 齊受禪，得除領軍將軍，別封安定侯。
units.en: When Qi received the abdication, he was appointed General of the Guard Army and received a separate enfeoffment as Marquis of Anding.
units.literal: When Qi received the abdication, he was appointed General of the Guard Army and separately enfeoffed as Marquis of Anding.

units.zh: 叡無他器干，以外戚貴幸，縱情財色。
units.en: Rui had no special ability, but as an imperial in-law he enjoyed rank and favor, and gave himself over to wealth and women.
units.literal: Rui had no other capacity; because he was a maternal relative he was honored and favored, and he gave himself over to wealth and women.

units.zh: 為瀛州刺史，聚斂無厭。
units.en: As Inspector of Ying Province, he extorted endlessly.
units.literal: As Inspector of Ying Province, he amassed exactions without satiety.

units.zh: 皇建初，封東安王。
units.en: At the beginning of Huangjian, he was made Prince of Dong'an.
units.literal: At the beginning of Huangjian, he was enfeoffed as Prince of Dong'an.

units.zh: 大寧元年，進位司空。
units.en: In the first year of Daning, he was promoted to Minister of Works.
units.literal: In the first year of Daning, his rank was advanced to Minister of Works.

units.zh: 平高歸彥於冀州，還拜司徒。
units.en: After suppressing Gao Guiyan in Ji Province, he returned and was appointed Minister over the Masses.
units.literal: He pacified Gao Guiyan in Ji Province, and on returning was appointed Minister over the Masses.

units.zh: 河清三年，濫殺人，為尚書左丞宋仲羨彈奏，經赦乃免。
units.en: In the third year of Heqing, he killed people indiscriminately and was impeached by Song Zhongxian, Left Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs; he escaped punishment only through an amnesty.
units.literal: In the third year of Heqing, he killed people indiscriminately and was impeached by Song Zhongxian, Left Assistant Director of the Department of State Affairs; only after an amnesty was he spared.

units.zh: 尋為太尉，以軍功進大司馬。
units.en: Soon he was made Grand Commandant and, for military merit, promoted to Grand Marshal.
units.literal: Soon he became Grand Commandant, and for military merit advanced to Grand Marshal.

units.zh: 武成至河陽，仍遣總偏師赴懸瓠。
units.en: When Emperor Wucheng reached Heyang, Rui was sent to command a detached force to Xuanhu.
units.literal: When Wucheng reached Heyang, he was then sent to command a detached force to Xuanhu.

units.zh: 叡在豫境留停百餘日，專行非法，詔免官，以王還第。
units.en: Rui stayed in Yu territory for more than a hundred days, acting lawlessly. An edict removed him from office, and he returned home retaining his princely title.
units.literal: Rui lingered in Yu territory for more than a hundred days and acted entirely unlawfully; an edict removed him from office, and he returned to his residence with his princely rank.

units.zh: 尋除太尉，薨。
units.en: Soon he was appointed Grand Commandant, then died.
units.literal: Soon he was appointed Grand Commandant and died.

units.zh: 贈大司馬。
units.en: He was posthumously granted the title Grand Marshal.
units.literal: He was posthumously granted Grand Marshal.

units.zh: 子子彥嗣，位開府儀同三司。
units.en: His son Ziyan succeeded him and rose to Opening Office with the same honors as the Three Excellencies.
units.literal: His son Ziyan succeeded, reaching the rank of Opening Office with the same honors as the Three Excellencies.

units.zh: 厙狄干，善無人也。
units.en: Kudie Gan was from Shanwu.
units.literal: Kudie Gan was a man of Shanwu.

units.zh: 曾祖越豆眷，魏道武時以功割善無之西臘汙山地方百里以處之，後率部北遷，因家朔方。
units.en: His great-grandfather Yuedoujuan was granted a hundred li of land at Xilawu Mountain west of Shanwu for his service under Emperor Daowu of Wei. He later led his people north and settled in Shuofang.
units.literal: His great-grandfather Yuedoujuan, in the time of Emperor Daowu of Wei, was allotted for his merit a hundred li of land at Xilawu Mountain west of Shanwu on which to settle; later he led his tribe northward and thus made his home in Shuofang.

units.zh: 干梗直少言，有武藝。
units.en: Gan was blunt and upright, sparing of speech, and skilled in arms.
units.literal: Gan was blunt and upright, spoke little, and possessed martial skill.

units.zh: 魏正光初，除掃逆黨，授將軍，宿衛於內。
units.en: At the beginning of Zhengguang in Wei, he was appointed to sweep away rebel bands, made a general, and assigned to the inner palace guard.
units.literal: At the beginning of Zhengguang in Wei, he was appointed to sweep away rebel bands, was granted the title of general, and served on guard inside the palace.

units.zh: 以家在寒鄉，不宜毒暑，冬得入京師，夏歸鄉里。
units.en: Because his home was in a cold region and he could not bear severe summer heat, he was allowed to spend winters in the capital and return home in summer.
units.literal: Because his home was in a cold region and he was not suited to fierce summer heat, in winter he was permitted to enter the capital and in summer to return to his native place.

units.zh: 孝昌元年，北邊擾亂，奔雲中，為刺史費穆送於尒朱榮。
units.en: In the first year of Xiaochang, when the northern frontier fell into disorder, he fled to Yunzhong and was sent by Inspector Fei Mu to Erzhu Rong.
units.literal: In the first year of Xiaochang, when the northern frontier fell into disorder, he fled to Yunzhong and was sent by Inspector Fei Mu to Erzhu Rong.

units.zh: 以軍主隨榮入洛。
units.en: As an army commander, he followed Erzhu Rong into Luoyang.
units.literal: As an army commander, he followed Rong into Luoyang.

units.zh: 後從神武起兵，破四胡於韓陵，封廣平縣公，尋進郡公。
units.en: Later he followed Gao Huan in raising arms, routed the Four Hus at Hanling, was enfeoffed duke of Guangping County, and soon advanced to commandery duke.
units.literal: Later he followed Shenwu in raising troops, defeated the Four Hus at Hanling, was enfeoffed Duke of Guangping County, and soon advanced to commandery duke.

units.zh: 河陰之役，諸將大捷，唯干兵退。
units.en: At Heyin the other generals won great victories — only Gan's troops fell back.
units.literal: At the Battle of Heyin the other generals won great victories — only Gan's troops retreated.

units.zh: 神武以其舊功，竟不責黜。
units.en: Gao Huan, weighing his old service, did not punish or dismiss him.
units.literal: Shenwu, considering his past merit, did not punish or dismiss him.

units.zh: 尋轉太保、太傅。
units.en: Soon he was made grand preceptor and grand tutor.
units.literal: Soon he was made Grand Preceptor and Grand Tutor.

units.zh: 及高仲密以武牢叛，神武討之，以干為大都督前驅。
units.en: When Gao Zhongmi rebelled at Wulao, Gao Huan marched against him and made Gan grand commander of the vanguard.
units.literal: When Gao Zhongmi rebelled at Wulao, Shenwu marched against him and made Gan grand commander as vanguard.

units.zh: 干上道不過家，見侯景不遑食，景使騎追饋之。
units.en: Gan took the road without stopping at home. He met Hou Jing and had no time to eat — Jing sent riders racing after him with provisions.
units.literal: Gan set out without stopping at home; he met Hou Jing and had no time to eat — Jing sent horsemen racing after him with food.

units.zh: 時文帝自將兵至洛陽，軍容甚盛。
units.en: Emperor Wen of Western Wei had personally led troops to Luoyang — his army's bearing was formidable.
units.literal: At that time Emperor Wen personally led troops to Luoyang; his army's appearance was very imposing.

units.zh: 諸將未欲南度，干決計濟河。
units.en: The generals shrank from crossing south; Gan resolved to ford the river.
units.literal: The generals did not wish to cross south; Gan resolved to ford the river.

units.zh: 神武大兵繼至，遂大破之。
units.en: Gao Huan's main army came up behind, and they routed the enemy.
units.literal: Shenwu's main force followed, and they routed the enemy.

units.zh: 還為定州刺史。
units.en: He returned and was made governor of Ding Province.
units.literal: He returned and was made Governor of Ding Province.

units.zh: 不閑吏事，事多擾煩，然清約自居，不為吏人所患。
units.en: He was no hand at administration, and his office was often in disorder — yet he lived plainly and frugally, and neither clerks nor commoners resented him.
units.literal: Unskilled in administration, his affairs were often chaotic — yet he kept himself frugal and simple, and the clerks and people did not resent him.

units.zh: 遷太師。
units.en: He was made grand preceptor.
units.literal: He was transferred to Grand Preceptor.

units.zh: 天保初，以天平元勳佐命，封章武郡王，轉太宰。
units.en: At the beginning of Tianbao, for his merit among the Tianping founding ministers, he was enfeoffed Prince of Zhangwu Commandery and made grand minister.
units.literal: At the beginning of Tianbao, for his merit as one of the founding ministers of the Tianping era, he was enfeoffed Prince of Zhangwu Commandery and made Grand Minister.

units.zh: 干尚神武妹樂陵長公主，以親地見待。
units.en: Gan married Gao Huan's sister, Princess of Leling — as kin by marriage, he was treated with singular favor.
units.literal: Gan married Shenwu's sister, Princess of Leling — as kin by marriage, he was treated with special favor.

units.zh: 自預勤王，常總大衆，威望之重，為諸將所伏，而最為嚴猛。
units.en: From the first campaigns to rescue the throne he often commanded the main armies. The weight of his prestige bowed the other generals — and of them all he was the sternest, the fiercest.
units.literal: From his first service in the rescue of the throne he often commanded the main armies; the weight of his prestige made the other generals defer to him, and he was the sternest and fiercest of them all.

units.zh: 會詣京師，魏譙王元孝友於公門言戲過度，諸公無能面折者，干正色責之，孝友大慚，時人稱之。
units.en: Once at the capital, Yuan Xiaoyou, Prince Qiao of Wei, carried on with excessive ribaldry at court — and none of the nobles dared rebuke him to his face. Gan sternly reproached him. Xiaoyou was deeply shamed; men praised Gan for it.
units.literal: Once when he visited the capital, Yuan Xiaoyou, Prince Qiao of Wei, indulged in excessive ribaldry at court — none of the nobles could rebuke him to his face. Gan sternly reproached him; Xiaoyou was deeply ashamed, and contemporaries praised Gan.

units.zh: 薨，贈假黃鉞，太宰，給轀輬車，諡曰景烈。
units.en: He died. Posthumously he was granted the acting yellow battle-axe and grand minister rank, given an imperial carriage — posthumous name Jinglie.
units.literal: He died. Posthumously he was granted the Acting Yellow Battle-Axe and Grand Minister rank, given an imperial carriage; posthumous name Jinglie.

units.zh: 干不知書，署名為「干」字，逆上畫之，時人謂之穿錐。
units.en: Gan could not read. To sign his name he drew the character for Gan upside down — people called it "piercing the awl."
units.literal: Gan could not read; to sign his name he drew the character gan upside down — people called it "piercing the awl."

units.zh: 又有武將王周者，署名先為「吉」而後成其外，二人至子孫始並知書。
units.en: There was also the warrior Wang Zhou, who signed by writing the inner strokes of "ji" first and only then completing the character — not until their descendants did either family learn to read.
units.literal: There was also the warrior Wang Zhou, who signed by writing the inner part ji first and then completing the outer strokes — not until their descendants did either family learn to read.

units.zh: 干，皇建初配享神武廟庭。
units.en: At the beginning of Huangjian, Gan was granted posthumous sacrifice in Gao Huan's temple hall.
units.literal: At the beginning of Huangjian, Gan was granted posthumous sacrifice in Shenwu's temple hall.

units.zh: 子敬伏，位儀同三司，卒。
units.en: His son Jingfu rose to rank equal to the three excellencies and died.
units.literal: His son Jingfu rose to rank equal to the three excellencies and died.

units.zh: 子士文嗣。
units.en: His son Shiwen succeeded him.
units.literal: His son Shiwen succeeded him.

units.zh: 士文性孤真，雖鄰里至親，莫與通狎。
units.en: Shiwen was solitary and upright by nature — even nearest kin and neighbors he would not treat familiarly.
units.literal: Shiwen was solitary and upright by nature; even nearest kin and neighbors he would not treat familiarly.

units.zh: 在齊，襲封章武郡王，位領軍將軍。
units.en: Under Qi he inherited the title Prince of Zhangwu Commandery and served as commander of the guard army.
units.literal: Under Qi he inherited the title Prince of Zhangwu Commandery and served as Commander of the Guard Army.

units.zh: 周武帝平齊，山東衣冠多來迎，唯士文閉門自守。
units.en: When Emperor Wu of Zhou conquered Qi, the gentry of Shandong poured out to welcome the conquerors — Shiwen alone shut his gates and held himself apart.
units.literal: When Emperor Wu of Zhou conquered Qi, many gentry of Shandong came out to welcome the conquerors — Shiwen alone shut his gates and held himself apart.

units.zh: 帝奇之，授開府儀同三司，隨州刺史。
units.en: The emperor admired this and made him holder of opening-establishment honors equal to the three excellencies, and governor of Sui Province.
units.literal: The emperor admired this and made him holder of opening-establishment honors equal to the three excellencies and Governor of Sui Province.

units.zh: 隋文受禪，加上開府，封湖陂縣子。
units.en: When Emperor Wen of Sui received the abdication, he was additionally granted supreme opening-establishment honors and enfeoffed viscount of Hubo County.
units.literal: When Emperor Wen of Sui received the abdication, he was additionally granted supreme opening-establishment honors and enfeoffed Viscount of Hubo County.

units.zh: 尋拜貝州刺史。
units.en: Soon he was made governor of Bei Province.
units.literal: Soon he was made Governor of Bei Province.

units.zh: 性清苦，不受公料，家無餘財。
units.en: By nature austere and frugal, he took no official stipend — his household held no surplus.
units.literal: By nature austere and frugal, he took no official stipend; his household had no surplus wealth.

units.zh: 其子嘗啖官廚餅，士文枷之於獄累日，杖之二百，步送還京，僮隸無敢出門。
units.en: Once his son ate cakes from the official kitchen. Shiwen had him shackled in prison for days, beaten two hundred strokes, and sent back to the capital on foot — not one servant dared leave the house.
units.literal: Once his son ate cakes from the official kitchen; Shiwen had him shackled in prison for days, beaten two hundred strokes, and sent back to the capital on foot — not one servant dared leave the house.

units.zh: 所買鹽菜，必於外境。
units.en: Salt and vegetables he bought had to come from outside his jurisdiction.
units.literal: Salt and vegetables he bought had to come from outside the jurisdiction.

units.zh: 凡有出入，皆封署其門，親故絕跡，慶吊不通。
units.en: Whenever he went out or returned, he sealed and signed his gate. Kin and friends ceased to visit; congratulations and condolences alike went unacknowledged.
units.literal: Whenever he went out or returned, he sealed and signed his gate — kin and friends ceased to visit; congratulations and condolences alike went unacknowledged.

units.zh: 法令嚴肅，吏人貼服，道不拾遺。
units.en: His laws were stern; officials and people submitted. Lost goods lay untouched on the road.
units.literal: His laws were stern; officials and people submitted; no one picked up lost goods on the road.

units.zh: 凡有細過，必深文陷害之。
units.en: For the slightest fault he would twist the law to destroy a man.
units.literal: For the slightest fault he would twist the law to destroy a man.

units.zh: 嘗入朝，遇上賜公卿入左藏，任取多少。
units.en: Once at court he encountered the emperor granting the high officials entry to the left treasury — take whatever you will.
units.literal: Once when he came to court, he encountered the emperor granting the high officials entry to the left treasury to take whatever they wished.

units.zh: 人皆極重，士文獨口銜絹一匹，兩手各持一匹。
units.en: Everyone took the heaviest loads. Shiwen alone held one bolt of silk in his mouth and one in each hand.
units.literal: Everyone took the heaviest loads; Shiwen alone held one bolt of silk in his mouth and one in each hand.

units.zh: 上問其故，士文曰：「臣口手俱足，餘無所須。」
units.en: The emperor asked why. Shiwen said, "My mouth and hands are both full — I require nothing else."
units.literal: The emperor asked why; Shiwen said, "My mouth and hands are both full — I require nothing else."

units.zh: 上異之，別齎遺之。
units.en: The emperor marveled and sent him separate gifts.
units.literal: The emperor marveled and separately sent him gifts.

units.zh: 士文至州，發摘姦吏，尺布鬥粟之贓，無所寬貸，得千人奏之，悉配防嶺南。
units.en: At his province Shiwen rooted out corrupt officials — embezzling even a foot of cloth or a pint of grain earned no mercy. A thousand men were reported up; all were sent to garrison Lingnan.
units.literal: When Shiwen reached his province, he rooted out corrupt officials — embezzling even a foot of cloth or a pint of grain earned no mercy. A thousand men were reported and all were sent to garrison duty in Lingnan.

units.zh: 親戚相送，哭聲遍於州境。
units.en: Kin escorted them weeping — their cries filled the province.
units.literal: Kin escorted them weeping; their cries filled the province.

units.zh: 至嶺南，遇瘴厲死者十八九，於是父母妻子唯哭士文。
units.en: Reaching Lingnan, eight or nine in ten died of miasma and pestilence — and parents, wives, and children wept only for Shiwen.
units.literal: Reaching Lingnan, eight or nine in ten died of miasma and pestilence — parents, wives, and children wept only for Shiwen.

units.zh: 士文聞之，令人捕搦，捶楚盈前，而哭者彌甚。
units.en: Hearing this, Shiwen had them seized and beaten until the whips piled before him — and the weeping only grew louder.
units.literal: Hearing this, Shiwen had them seized and beaten until the whips piled up before him — and the weeping grew louder.

units.zh: 司馬京兆韋焜、清河令河東趙達二人並苛刻，唯長史有惠政，時人語曰：「刺史羅剎政，司馬蝮蛇瞋，長史含笑判，清河生吃人。」
units.en: Vice director Wei Kun of Jingzhao and magistrate of Qinghe Zhao Da of Hedong were both harsh; only the chief clerk governed with kindness. People said, "The governor's policy is a rakshasa's; the vice director glares like a viper; the chief clerk judges with a smile; Qinghe's magistrate devours men alive."
units.literal: Vice Director Wei Kun of Jingzhao and Magistrate of Qinghe Zhao Da of Hedong were both harsh; only the Chief Clerk governed with kindness. People said: "The governor's policy is a rakshasa's; the vice director glares like a viper; the chief clerk judges with a smile; Qinghe's magistrate devours men alive."

units.zh: 上聞，嘆曰：「士文暴過猛獸。」
units.en: The emperor heard and sighed, "Shiwen is more savage than a wild beast."
units.literal: The emperor heard and sighed: "Shiwen is more savage than a wild beast."

units.zh: 竟坐免。
units.en: In the end he was dismissed.
units.literal: In the end he was dismissed for it.

units.zh: 未幾為雍州長史，謂人曰：「我向法深，不能窺候要貴，無乃必死此官。」
units.en: Before long he was made chief clerk of Yong Province. He told people, "My laws have always been severe; I cannot court the mighty. I suppose I will die in this post."
units.literal: Before long he was made Chief Clerk of Yong Province. He told people: "My laws have always been severe; I cannot court the mighty. I suppose I will die in this post."

units.zh: 及下車，執法嚴正，不避貴戚，賓客莫敢至門。
units.en: When he took up the post he enforced the law without fear of noble kin — not one guest dared come to his door.
units.literal: When he took up the post he enforced the law with rigor, fearing no noble kin; not one guest dared come to his door.

units.zh: 人多怨望。
units.en: Many nursed resentment against him.
units.literal: Many nursed resentment against him.

units.zh: 士文從妹為齊氏嬪，有色，齊滅後，賜薛公長孫覽。
units.en: Shiwen's cousin had been a concubine of Qi — beautiful. After Qi's fall she was given to Changsun Lan, Duke of Xue.
units.literal: Shiwen's cousin had been a concubine of Qi — beautiful; after Qi's fall she was given to Changsun Lan, Duke of Xue.

units.zh: 覽妻鄭氏妬，譖之文獻后，后令覽離絕。
units.en: Lan's wife Lady Zheng, jealous, slandered her to Empress Wenxian — and the empress ordered Lan to cast her off.
units.literal: Lan's wife Lady Zheng, jealous, slandered her to Empress Wenxian; the empress ordered Lan to separate from her.

units.zh: 士文恥之，不與相見。
units.en: Shiwen was shamed and refused to see her.
units.literal: Shiwen was shamed and refused to meet with her.

units.zh: 後應州刺史唐君明居母憂，娉以為妻，由是君明、士文並為御史所劾。
units.en: Later, when Tang Junming, governor of Ying Province, was in mourning for his mother, he took her as his wife — for this both Junming and Shiwen were impeached by the censorate.
units.literal: Later, when Tang Junming, Governor of Ying Province, was in mourning for his mother, he took her as his wife — for this both Junming and Shiwen were impeached by the censorate.

units.zh: 士文性剛，在獄數日，憤恚而死，家無餘財，有三子，朝夕不繼，親賓無贍之者。
units.en: Shiwen was unyielding by nature. After a few days in prison he died of rage and indignation. His household held nothing spare; three sons went hungry morning and evening — neither kin nor friends would support them.
units.literal: Shiwen was unyielding by nature; after a few days in prison he died of rage and indignation. His household had no surplus; three sons went hungry morning and evening — neither kin nor friends would support them.

units.zh: 韓軌，字百年，太安狄那人也。
units.en: Han Gui, courtesy name Bainian, was a native of Dina in Tai'an.
units.literal: Han Gui, courtesy name Bainian, was a native of Dina in Tai'an.

units.zh: 少有志操，性深沈，喜怒不形於色。
units.en: From youth he had resolution and integrity — deep and reserved, he never showed pleasure or anger on his face.
units.literal: From youth he had resolution and integrity; deep and reserved, he never showed pleasure or anger on his face.

units.zh: 神武鎮晉州，引為鎮城都督。
units.en: When Gao Huan held Jin Province, he recruited Gui as garrison commander of the walled city.
units.literal: When Shenwu held Jin Province, he recruited Gui as garrison commander of the walled city.

units.zh: 及起兵於信都，軌贊成大策。
units.en: When arms were raised at Xindu, Gui supported the great plan.
units.literal: When troops were raised at Xindu, Gui supported the great plan.

units.zh: 從破尒朱兆於廣阿，又從韓陵陣，封平昌縣侯。
units.en: He followed in the defeat of Erzhu Zhao at Guang'a and fought at Hanling — and was enfeoffed marquis of Pingchang County.
units.literal: He followed in the defeat of Erzhu Zhao at Guang'a and fought at Hanling; he was enfeoffed Marquis of Pingchang County.

units.zh: 仍督中軍，從破尒朱兆於赤谼嶺。
units.en: He continued to command the center army and followed in the defeat of Erzhu Zhao at Chihong Ridge.
units.literal: He continued to command the center army and followed in the defeat of Erzhu Zhao at Chihong Ridge.

units.zh: 再遷泰州刺史。
units.en: He was made governor of Tai Province.
units.literal: He was twice transferred and made Governor of Tai Province.

units.zh: 甚得邊和。
units.en: He won deep peace on the frontier.
units.literal: He won great peace on the frontier.

units.zh: 神武巡泰州，欲以軌還，仍賜城人戶別絹布兩匹。
units.en: When Gao Huan inspected Tai Province and wished to transfer Gui away, he granted each household in the city two bolts of silk and cloth.
units.literal: When Shenwu inspected Tai Province and wished to transfer Gui away, he granted each household in the city two bolts of silk and cloth apiece.

units.zh: 州人田昭等七千戶皆辭不受，唯乞留軌。
units.en: Seven thousand households led by Tian Zhao declined the gift and begged only that Gui remain.
units.literal: Seven thousand households led by Tian Zhao all declined the gift and begged only that Gui remain.

units.zh: 神武嘉嘆，乃留焉。
units.en: Gao Huan praised and sighed with admiration — and kept him.
units.literal: Shenwu praised and sighed with admiration — and kept him.

units.zh: 頻以軍功，進封安德郡公。
units.en: Again and again for military merit he was advanced to duke of Ande Commandery.
units.literal: Repeatedly for military merit he was advanced to Duke of Ande Commandery.

units.zh: 遷瀛州刺史，在州聚斂，為御史糾劾，削除官爵。
units.en: Made governor of Ying Province, he amassed wealth in office — the censorate impeached him and stripped his office and rank.
units.literal: Made Governor of Ying Province, he accumulated wealth in the province; the censorate impeached him and stripped his office and rank.

units.zh: 未幾，復其安德郡公。
units.en: Before long his ducal title of Ande was restored.
units.literal: Before long his ducal title of Ande was restored.

units.zh: 歷位中書令、司徒。
units.en: He rose through director of the secretariat and minister of education.
units.literal: He rose through the posts of Director of the Secretariat and Minister of Education.

units.zh: 齊受禪，封安德郡王。
units.en: When Qi received the abdication, he was enfeoffed Prince of Ande Commandery.
units.literal: When Qi received the abdication, he was enfeoffed Prince of Ande Commandery.

units.zh: 軌妹為神武所納，生上黨王渙，復以勳庸，歷登臺鉉。
units.en: Gao Huan took Gui's younger sister as consort; she bore Prince Huan of Shangdang. Again through merit Gui rose to the highest offices of state.
units.literal: Shenwu took Gui's younger sister as consort; she bore Prince Huan of Shangdang. Again through merit Gui rose to the highest offices of state.

units.zh: 常以謙恭自處，不以富貴驕人。
units.en: He always conducted himself with humility — never lording his wealth and rank over others.
units.literal: He always conducted himself with humility and deference, never lording his wealth and rank over others.

units.zh: 後拜大司馬，從文宣征蠕蠕，在軍暴疾薨。
units.en: Later he was made grand marshal. Campaigning against the Rouran with Wenxuan, he died suddenly of illness in camp.
units.literal: Later he was made Grand Marshal; campaigning against the Rouran with Wenxuan, he died suddenly of illness in camp.

units.zh: 贈假黃鉞，太宰、太師，諡曰肅武。
units.en: Posthumously he was granted the acting yellow battle-axe, grand minister and grand preceptor — posthumous name Suwu.
units.literal: Posthumously granted the Acting Yellow Battle-Axe, Grand Minister and Grand Preceptor; posthumous name Suwu.

units.zh: 皇建初，配饗文襄廟庭。
units.en: At the beginning of Huangjian he was granted posthumous sacrifice in Wenxiang's temple hall.
units.literal: At the beginning of Huangjian he was granted posthumous sacrifice in Wenxiang's temple hall.

units.zh: 子晉明嗣。
units.en: His son Jinming succeeded him.
units.literal: His son Jinming succeeded him.

units.zh: 天統中，改封東萊王。
units.en: During Tiantong his title was changed to Prince of Donglai.
units.literal: During Tiantong his title was changed to Prince of Donglai.

units.zh: 晉明有俠氣，諸勳貴子孫中最留心學問。
units.en: Jinming had a chivalrous spirit — among the sons of meritorious nobles he was most devoted to learning.
units.literal: Jinming had a chivalrous spirit; among the sons of meritorious nobles he was most devoted to learning.

units.zh: 好酒誕縱，招引賓客，一席之費，動至萬錢，猶恨儉率。
units.en: He loved wine and lived without restraint, gathering guests — a single feast often cost ten thousand cash, and he still complained it was too spare.
units.literal: He loved wine and lived without restraint, gathering guests — a single feast often cost ten thousand cash, and he still complained it was too frugal.

units.zh: 朝庭處之貴要之地，必以疾辭。
units.en: Whenever the court offered him a lofty post, he declined on grounds of illness.
units.literal: Whenever the court offered him a lofty post, he declined on grounds of illness.

units.zh: 告人云：「廢人飲美酒、封名勝，安能作刀筆吏返披故紙乎？」
units.en: He told people, "A useless man drinking fine wine and sealing famous vistas — how could I go back to being a clerk pawing over old papers?"
units.literal: He told people: "A useless man drinking fine wine and sealing famous vistas — how could I go back to being a clerk pawing over old papers?"

units.zh: 武平末，除尚書左僕射，百餘日便謝病解官。
units.en: At the end of Wuping he was made left vice director of the Masters of Writing — after little more than a hundred days he resigned on grounds of illness.
units.literal: At the end of Wuping he was made Left Vice Director of the Masters of Writing; after little more than a hundred days he resigned on grounds of illness.

units.zh: 潘樂，字相貴，廣寧石門人也。
units.en: Pan Le, courtesy name Xianggui, was a native of Shimen in Guangning.
units.literal: Pan Le, courtesy name Xianggui, was a native of Shimen in Guangning.

units.zh: 本廣宗大族，魏世分鎮北邊，因家焉。
units.en: Originally a great clan of Guangzong — in Wei times they were posted to guard the northern frontier and settled there.
units.literal: Originally a great clan of Guangzong, in Wei times they were posted to guard the northern frontier and settled there.

units.zh: 父永，有技藝，襲爵廣宗男。
units.en: His father Yong had technical skills and inherited the barony of Guangzong.
units.literal: His father Yong had technical skills and inherited the barony of Guangzong.

units.zh: 樂初生，有一雀止其母左肩，占者咸言富貴之徵，因名相貴，後始為字。
units.en: When Le was born a sparrow alighted on his mother's left shoulder. Diviners all said it was a sign of wealth and rank — hence the name Xianggui, later adopted as his courtesy name.
units.literal: When Le was born a sparrow alighted on his mother's left shoulder; diviners all said it was a sign of wealth and rank — hence the name Xianggui, later adopted as his courtesy name.

units.zh: 及長，寬厚有膽略。
units.en: When he grew up he was generous and broad-minded, possessed of courage and strategy.
units.literal: When he grew up he was generous, broad-minded, and possessed of courage and strategy.

units.zh: 初歸葛榮，授京兆王，時年十九。
units.en: At first he joined Ge Rong and was made Prince of Jingzhao — he was nineteen.
units.literal: At first he joined Ge Rong and was made Prince of Jingzhao — he was nineteen.

units.zh: 榮敗，隨尒朱榮，為別將討元顥，以功封敷城縣男。
units.en: When Rong was defeated he followed Erzhu Rong, served as a separate commander against Yuan Hao, and for merit was enfeoffed baron of Fucheng County.
units.literal: When Rong was defeated he followed Erzhu Rong, served as a separate commander against Yuan Hao, and for merit was enfeoffed Baron of Fucheng County.

units.zh: 齊神武出牧晉州，引樂為鎮城都將。
units.en: When Gao Huan went out to hold Jin Province, he recruited Le as garrison general of the walled city.
units.literal: When Shenwu went out to hold Jin Province, he recruited Le as garrison general of the walled city.

units.zh: 從破尒朱兆於廣阿，進爵廣宗縣伯。
units.en: He followed in the defeat of Erzhu Zhao at Guang'a and was advanced to earl of Guangzong County.
units.literal: He followed in the defeat of Erzhu Zhao at Guang'a and was advanced to Earl of Guangzong County.

units.zh: 累以軍功拜東雍州刺史。
units.en: Again and again for military merit he was made governor of Eastern Yong Province.
units.literal: Repeatedly for military merit he was made Governor of Eastern Yong Province.

units.zh: 神武嘗議欲廢州，樂以東雍地帶山河，境連胡、蜀，形勝之會，不可棄也，遂如故。
units.en: Gao Huan once debated abolishing the province. Le argued that Eastern Yong lay between mountains and rivers, bordered Hu and Shu, and occupied a strategically vital junction — it could not be abandoned. The province remained as before.
units.literal: Shenwu once debated abolishing the province; Le argued that Eastern Yong lay between mountains and rivers, bordered Hu and Shu territories, and occupied a strategically vital junction — it could not be abandoned. The province remained as before.

units.zh: 後破周師於河陰，議欲追之，令追者在西，不願者東，唯樂與劉豐居西。
units.en: Later, after defeating Zhou troops at Heyin, there was debate over pursuit — those willing to pursue stood west, the unwilling east. Only Le and Liu Feng stood on the west.
units.literal: Later, after defeating Zhou troops at Heyin, there was debate over pursuit — those willing to pursue stood west, the unwilling east. Only Le and Liu Feng stood on the west.

units.zh: 神武善之，以衆議不同而止。
units.en: Gao Huan approved — but because the council could not agree, he dropped the pursuit.
units.literal: Shenwu approved of it; because the multitude's counsels differed, he ceased.

units.zh: 改封金門郡公。
units.en: He was re-enfeoffed as duke of Jinmen Commandery.
units.literal: His enfeoffment was changed to Duke of Jinmen Commandery.

units.zh: 文宣嗣事，鎮河陽，破西將楊檦等。
units.en: When Gao Yang succeeded to power, Le held the Heyang garrison and routed Western general Yang Piao and others.
units.literal: When Wenxuan succeeded to affairs, Le garrisoned Heyang and defeated Western generals Yang Piao and others.

units.zh: 時帝以懷州刺史平鑒等所築城深入敵境，欲棄之，樂以軹關要害，必須防固，乃更修理，增置兵將，而還鎮河陽，拜司空。
units.en: The emperor wished to abandon fortifications built by Huai Province governor Ping Jian and others, because they lay deep in enemy territory. Pan Le argued that Zhiguan Pass was a vital strongpoint and had to be held; he repaired the works, posted more troops and officers, returned to garrison Heyang, and was appointed minister of works.
units.literal: At the time the emperor, because the walled fort built by Huai Province Governor Ping Jian and others lay deep in enemy territory, wished to abandon it; Le, holding that Zhiguan Pass was a strategic strongpoint that must be defended, thereupon repaired it further, added troops and commanders, returned to garrison Heyang, and was appointed Minister of Works.

units.zh: 齊受禪，樂進璽綬。
units.en: When Qi received the abdication, Pan Le presented the imperial seal and cord.
units.literal: When Qi received the Mandate, Le presented the seal and cord.

units.zh: 進封河東郡王，遷司徒。
units.en: He was advanced to Prince of Hedong Commandery and transferred to minister over the masses.
units.literal: Advanced in enfeoffment to Prince of Hedong Commandery; transferred to Minister over the Masses.

units.zh: 周文東至崤、陜，遣其行臺侯莫陳崇自齊子嶺趣軹關，儀同楊檦從鼓鐘道出建州，陷孤公戍。
units.en: Yuwen Tai marched east to Xiao and Shan, sending field headquarters Houmochen Chong from Qizi Ridge against Zhiguan Pass while yitong Yang Piao by the Guchong road into Jian Province captured the Gugong garrison.
units.literal: Zhou Wen marched east to Xiao and Shan, dispatching his field headquarters Houmochen Chong from Qizi Ridge toward Zhiguan, while Yitong Yang Piao by the Guchong road out toward Jian Province captured Gugong garrison.

units.zh: 詔樂總大衆禦之。
units.en: An edict ordered Pan Le to take overall command and meet the invasion.
units.literal: An edict ordered Le to command the great host to resist.

units.zh: 樂晝夜兼行，至長子，遣儀同韓永興從建州西趣崇，崇遂遁。
units.en: Pan Le forced the march day and night as far as Changzi, sent yitong Han Yongxing west from Jian Province against Houmochen Chong — and Chong fled.
units.literal: Le marched day and night without pause; reaching Changzi, he dispatched Yitong Han Yongxing west from Jian Province toward Chong, and Chong thereupon fled.

units.zh: 又為南道大都督，討侯景。
units.en: He was again made grand governor of the south route and sent against Hou Jing.
units.literal: Again made Grand Governor of the Southern Route, to campaign against Hou Jing.

units.zh: 樂發石鱉，南度百餘里，至梁涇州。
units.en: Pan Le marched out from Shibie, drove south more than a hundred li, and reached Jing Province in Liang territory.
units.literal: Le set out from Shibie, marched south over a hundred li, and reached Liang's Jing Province.

units.zh: 涇州舊在石梁，侯景改為懷州，樂獲其地，仍立涇州，又克安州。
units.en: Jing Province had stood at Shiliang until Hou Jing renamed it Huai Province. Pan Le recovered the ground, restored Jing Province, and also took An Province.
units.literal: Jing Province had formerly been at Shiliang; Hou Jing had changed it to Huai Province. Le recovered the territory, re-established Jing Province, and also captured An Province.

units.zh: 除瀛州刺史，仍略淮、漢。
units.en: He was appointed governor of Ying Province and continued to carry the war into the Huai and Han country.
units.literal: Appointed Governor of Ying Province; still raided Huai and Han.

units.zh: 天保六年，薨於懸瓠。
units.en: In the sixth year of Tianbao he died at Xuanhu.
units.literal: In the sixth year of Tianbao, he died at Xuanhu.

units.zh: 贈假黃鉞，太師、大司馬、尚書令。
units.en: Posthumously he was granted the acting yellow battle-axe, grand preceptor, grand marshal, and director of the Masters of Writing.
units.literal: Posthumously granted Acting Yellow Battle-Axe, Grand Preceptor, Grand Marshal, and Director of the Masters of Writing.

units.zh: 子子晃嗣。
units.en: His son Zihuan succeeded to the line.
units.literal: His son Zihuan succeeded.

units.zh: 諸將子弟，率多驕縱，子晃沈密謹愨，以清凈自居。
units.en: The sons of the great generals were mostly proud and undisciplined; Zihuan was grave, careful, and dutiful, claiming only quiet integrity for himself.
units.literal: The sons of the various generals were mostly arrogant and unrestrained; Zihuan was deep, meticulous, cautious and reverent, holding himself to purity and restraint.

units.zh: 尚公主，拜駙馬都尉。
units.en: He married an imperial princess and was appointed commandant of the emperor's son-in-law.
units.literal: Married the princess; appointed Commandant of Attendants for the Son-in-Law.

units.zh: 武平末，為幽州道行臺右僕射、幽州刺史。
units.en: At the end of the Wuping era he served as right vice director of the You Province circuit field headquarters and governor of You Province.
units.literal: At the end of Wuping, he served as Right Vice Director of the You Province Circuit Field Headquarters and Governor of You Province.

units.zh: 周師將入鄴，子晃率突騎數萬赴援。
units.en: When Northern Zhou armies were closing on Ye, Zihuan led tens of thousands of picked cavalry to the relief.
units.literal: When Zhou armies were about to enter Ye, Zihuan led tens of thousands of picked cavalry to go to the relief.

units.zh: 至博陵，知鄴城不守，詣冀州降。
units.en: He reached Baling, learned that Ye could not be held, and went to Ji Province to surrender.
units.literal: Reaching Baling, learning that Ye could not be held, he went to Ji Province and surrendered.

units.zh: 周授上開府。
units.en: Zhou granted him an upper opening establishment.
units.literal: Zhou granted Upper Opening Establishment.

units.zh: 隋大業初卒。
units.en: He died at the opening of the Daye era under Sui.
units.literal: In the early Daye era of Sui he died.

s0001.quote: 竇泰 尉景 婁昭 兄子叡 厙狄干 子士文 韓軌 潘樂

s0003.quote: 本出清河觀津，曾祖羅，魏統萬鎮將，因居北邊。

s0124.quote: 叡字佛仁，父拔，魏南部尚書。

s0127.quote: 在任貪縱，深為文襄所責。

s0141.quote: 子子彥嗣，位開府儀同三司。

s0178.quote: 其子嘗啖官廚餅，士文枷之於獄累日，杖之二百，步送還京，僮隸無敢出門。

s0183.quote: 嘗入朝，遇上賜公卿入左藏，任取多少。

s0187.quote: 士文至州，發摘姦吏，尺布鬥粟之贓，無所寬貸，得千人奏之，悉配防嶺南。

s0194.quote: 未幾為雍州長史，謂人曰：「我向法深，不能窺候要貴，無乃必死此官。」

s0201.quote: 士文性剛，在獄數日，憤恚而死，家無餘財，有三子，朝夕不繼，親賓無贍之者。

s0192.quote: 上聞，嘆曰：「士文暴過猛獸。」

s0191.quote: 司馬京兆韋焜、清河令河東趙達二人並苛刻，唯長史有惠政，時人語曰：「刺史羅剎政，司馬蝮蛇瞋，長史含笑判，清河生吃人。」

s0197.quote: 士文從妹為齊氏嬪，有色，齊滅後，賜薛公長孫覽。

s0198.quote: 覽妻鄭氏妬，譖之文獻后，后令覽離絕。

s0200.quote: 後應州刺史唐君明居母憂，娉以為妻，由是君明、士文並為御史所劾。

s0210.quote: 神武巡泰州，欲以軌還，仍賜城人戶別絹布兩匹。

s0211.quote: 州人田昭等七千戶皆辭不受，唯乞留軌。

s0218.quote: 軌妹為神武所納，生上黨王渙，復以勳庸，歷登臺鉉。
